test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the number of girls and boys in a school is 8 : 7. If the percentage increase in the number of girls and boys is 10% and 20% respectively, what will be the new ratio?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 8 x 110/100 : 7 x 120/100

⇒ 22 : 21

**∴ New Ratio is 22 : 21.**
